Name: Lighter Hair Colours (CP)
Author: MellyJustMelly
Description:
Mainly just another hair mod to have your hair be lighter. You can pick and choose which one you'd like. This is my first ever uploaded mod, and I picked something very easy. I definitely did some Content Patcher content before, mainly for myself. But this one was so much fun to work on I decided to share it.
Since this is my first ever uploaded mod, I hope I did everything correctly and I did test it multiple times in-game. I really hope nobody has any struggles.

This was mainly born thanks to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25262]True Hair Color[/url]﻿ Mod. I enjoy it, but I noticed it has less detailed shading, which is fine, but I wanted options to have the original shading of the game while still having the lighter feeling of the mod. I'm not sure if I managed to have the same feeling of said mod, but I think it's pretty good as of now.

Please note that this mod will not apply to modded hair as it only has the vanilla hair styles modded!

I hope you enjoy! <3
(Please excuse any typos or grammar mistake, I'm not good with this and English is my second language)
